name: hud_ui_triplet_add_entry
description: HudUiTriplet::AddEntry builds a scoreboard entry from a GameNet player row, grows the entry vector when needed, appends the entry, and rebuilds the displayed triplet scoreboard.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent HUD triplet/list-menu source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja frontier for 0x40e590 validates dependency on the triplet entry-vector GetCount/CopyRange/FillN helpers, vector clear/delete provider paths, strncpy, and HudUiTriplet::RebuildDisplay.
The native triplet scoreboard smoke verifies AddEntry for normal and 18-entry growth paths, player key/name/color entry fields, sorted vector order after rebuild, and rendered top-row text.
